answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 105 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the ripple challenge, the beacon audit can replay the zenith history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2161 identities would post 1363 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
